name: @paigasus/discovery
_comment_exports: FOUR subpath exports and deliberately NO ".". ./server and ./react are server-only. ./types (data types) and ./client (capabilityOutcome, reasonText, CapabilityDisabled — SMA-510, for @paigasus/app-shell) are client-safe. A root export re-exporting the server surface would let a client component import it and walk around the boundary — the same reason @paigasus/auth omits one. tests/structure/exports.test.ts pins this key set and the ./client import graph.
description: Lazy, request-scoped service capability discovery with three service states for Paigasus console zones.
